portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The p11-kit packages provide a mechanism to manage PKCS#11 modules. The
p11-kit-trust subpackage includes a PKCS#11 trust module that provides
certificate anchors and black lists based on configuration files.

The p11-kit packages have been upgraded to upstream version 0.20.7, which
provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version,
including thread-safe readdir() function, a fix for minor integer overflow in
the p11_buffer_append() function, a fix for occasional segmentation fault in the
p11_buffer_append() function, and an API that implements the external trust
policy. Moreover, this update adds a 'trust' tool to configure root certificate
anchors on the system. It also adds API that allows for other system components
such as GnuTLS to accept the certificate trust information. (BZ#1122528,
BZ#984989, BZ#985009, BZ#985019, BZ#985497,
BZ#1125965, BZ#1142305)

This update also fixes the following bugs:

* With this update, the behavior of static local variables has been optimized to
prevent accidental writes to these variables. (BZ#985337)

* Due to a bug in the coolkey p11-kit module, when using this module, other
modules were not included in the /etc/pki/nssdb file. This bug has been fixed,
and all p11-kit modules are now added to /etc/pki/nssdb as expected.
(BZ#1128615)

* Previously, multi-arch installations on IBM System z failed to integrate with
Network Security Services (NSS). This bug has been fixed, and multi-arch
installs now integrate with NSS correctly. (BZ#1174178)

Users of p11-kit are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
these bugs and add these enhancements. This update is required by gnutls
3.3.x packages.
